system.description:
Gray Elf

Gray elves, also known as Faerie elves or Valley elves in some regions, are considered the most noble and intelligent of all elven subraces. They stand slightly taller than high elves and are characterized by their silver or golden hair, pale amber or violet eyes, and an air of otherworldly elegance. Gray elves are reclusive and tend to look down upon other races, including other elves, from their remote mountain strongholds.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Intelligence: +2
  • Strength: −1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching.
  • Magical Aptitude: Gray elves can advance to higher levels in magic-related classes than other elves.
  • Bonus Spell Memorization: High Intelligence grants additional spell slots as per the magic-user rules.
  • Move Silently: As standard elves when in non-metal armor.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: +1 to attack rolls with bows and swords.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief; Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief multiclass.
